words.example: The abdomen is tender on the left.
words.notes: 腹部、下腹。stomach 也可指腹部。

words.example: The team may abort the operation.
words.exampleZh: 團隊可能中止這項手術。
words.notes: 中止。也可指使流產或夭折。miscarry 是流產，discontinue 是停止。

words.example: The clinic schedules a follow-up after an abortion.
words.exampleZh: 診所在流產後會安排回診。
words.notes: 流產，也可指墮胎。

words.example: My shoulders ache after the shift.
words.notes: 疼痛。不及物。也可指渴望。aching 可作形容詞。

words.example: She is allergic to penicillin.
words.notes: 過敏的。be allergic to 是對某物過敏。

words.example: The allergy is to dust.
words.notes: 過敏症。skin allergy 是皮膚過敏。drug allergy 是藥物過敏。

words.example: The lump is benign.
words.notes: 良性的，也可指溫和的。benign tumor 是良性腫瘤。

words.example: Insects bite at dusk near the pond.
words.exampleZh: 池塘邊的昆蟲在黃昏叮咬。
words.notes: 咬、刺痛。過去式 bit，過去分詞 bitten。

words.example: The cut will bleed if you pick it.
words.exampleZh: 這個傷口再去抓就會流血。
words.notes: 流血。不及物。過去式是 bled。

words.example: He has been blind in the left eye for years.
words.exampleZh: 他左眼失明已經好幾年。
words.notes: 瞎的、失明的。blind eye 是眼瞎。blind man 是盲人。

words.example: The blood test is at eight.
words.notes: 血、血液。draw blood 是抽血。test the blood 是驗血。

words.example: The bone needs six weeks.
words.notes: 骨頭、骨質。break a bone 是骨折。bone ash 是骨灰。

words.example: The brain scan is scheduled for noon.
words.notes: 大腦，也可指智力。

words.example: The exam includes a breast check.
words.notes: 乳房，也可指胸部或胸懷。breast cancer 是乳癌。breast milk 是母乳。

words.example: Hold one breath and count to four.
words.notes: 呼吸、氣息。last breath 是最後一口氣。in a breath 是立刻。

words.example: The climb left her breathless.
words.exampleZh: 這段爬坡讓她喘不過氣。
words.notes: 喘不過氣的，也可指停止呼吸的。

words.example: The bruise on the shin is fading.
words.notes: 瘀青、挫傷。abrasion 是擦傷。

words.example: The scan found no cancer.
words.notes: 癌症。常被視為難治的疾病。

words.example: The cavity is on a back tooth.
words.notes: 洞，也可指腔。oral cavity 是口腔。

words.example: The cheek is red on one side.
words.notes: 頰、臉頰。pale cheeks 是蒼白的臉頰。

words.example: The chest feels tight.
words.notes: 胸部、胸腔。chest pains 是胸部疼痛。

words.example: The concussion means no sport this week.
words.exampleZh: 腦震盪表示這週不能運動。
words.notes: 腦震盪，也可指搖動、震動。

words.example: He was conscious when help arrived.
words.exampleZh: 救援到達時他神志清醒。
words.notes: 神志清醒的，也可指意識到的。be conscious of 是意識到。

words.example: The study found no correlation.
words.exampleZh: 這份研究沒有找到相關性。
words.notes: 關係、相關性。relationship 與 association 是近義。

words.example: A dry cough lasted three days.
words.notes: 咳嗽。可作名詞或動詞。get a cough 是咳嗽起來。

words.example: A cramp woke her at midnight.
words.notes: 痙攣、抽筋。

words.example: The injury could cripple the joint.
words.exampleZh: 這個傷害可能讓關節嚴重受損。
words.notes: 使肢體功能嚴重受損。名詞指行動不便的人。

words.example: She is deaf in the right ear.
words.notes: 聾的，也可指不願聽的。deaf in the left ear 是左耳聾。

words.example: Sugar speeds tooth decay.
words.notes: 腐壞、衰退。fall into decay 是陷入衰敗。

words.example: The deformity is in the spine.
words.notes: 畸形。joint deformity 是關節畸形。body deformity 是身體畸形。

words.example: The disability does not block the job.
words.exampleZh: 這項失能不妨礙這份工作。
words.notes: 殘疾、功能受限。learning disability 是學習障礙。physical disability 是生理殘疾。

words.example: A stroke can disable one side.
words.exampleZh: 中風可使一側喪失能力。
words.notes: 使無法行動或無法做事。

words.example: The disease spreads in crowded rooms.
words.exampleZh: 這種疾病在擁擠的房間裡傳播。
words.notes: 疾病。catch a disease 是得病。common disease 是常見疾病。

words.example: Shock left him dumb for a minute.
words.exampleZh: 驚嚇讓他有一分鐘說不出話。
words.notes: 不能說話的。另一個意思是蠢的，如 dumb mistake。dumb show 是默劇。

words.example: The face is pale this morning.
words.notes: 臉，也可指面子。動詞是朝向。

words.example: The facial swelling has gone down.
words.notes: 面部的、臉的。facial expression 是面部表情。

words.example: Stand up slowly or you may faint.
words.exampleZh: 起身慢一點，不然可能昏倒。
words.notes: 暈倒、暈厥。

words.example: The feeble pulse worried the nurse.
words.exampleZh: 微弱的脈搏讓護理師擔心。
words.notes: 虛弱的、微弱的。frail 是虛弱的。

words.example: The fever broke before dawn.
words.notes: 熱、發燒。have a fever 是發燒。

words.example: The flu kept half the office home.
words.exampleZh: 流感讓辦公室一半的人留在家。
words.notes: 流感。have the flu 是患流感。bird flu 是禽流感。

words.example: The X-ray shows a fracture.
words.notes: 骨折、破裂。bone fracture 是骨折。fatigue fracture 是疲勞性骨折。

words.example: A gasp was all he could manage.
words.notes: 吸氣、喘氣。gasp for 是喘著氣想得到。

words.example: The gum around the tooth is red.
words.exampleZh: 這顆牙周圍的牙齦發紅。
words.notes: 牙齦，也可指樹膠。

words.example: The handicap does not stop the training.
words.exampleZh: 這項身心障礙沒有讓訓練停下來。
words.notes: 生理缺陷、障礙，也可指不利條件。

words.example: The headache started after lunch.
words.notes: 頭痛。have a headache 是頭痛。

words.example: A small cut can heal in a few days.
words.notes: 治癒、痊癒。heal up 與 heal over 都是癒合。

words.example: The heart rate is steady.
words.notes: 心臟。heart attack 是心臟病發作。

words.example: Does the knee hurt when you walk?
words.exampleZh: 走路時膝蓋會感到疼痛嗎？
words.notes: 受傷、疼痛。過去式仍是 hurt。

words.example: She was too ill to travel.
words.notes: 生病的，也可指壞的、惡意的。

words.example: The illness kept him in bed for a week.
words.exampleZh: 這場病痛讓他在床上躺了一週。
words.notes: 疾病、生病。mental illness 是精神疾病。recover from illness 是康復。

words.example: The vaccine can leave a person immune.
words.exampleZh: 疫苗可以讓人有免疫力。
words.notes: 有免疫力的、不受影響的。be immune to 是對某事免疫。

words.example: They called the condition incurable too soon.
words.exampleZh: 他們太早說這個病無法治癒。
words.notes: 不能醫治的。也可指無效的。

words.example: The plan says not to indulge every craving.
words.exampleZh: 計畫寫著不要放縱每一個嘴饞。
words.notes: 放縱、沉溺。indulge in 是沉溺於。

words.example: Extra sweets were an indulgence.
words.notes: 放縱、溺愛，舊義也可指贖宥。

words.example: Dirty hands can infect a wound.
words.exampleZh: 髒手可能讓傷口受到傳染。
words.notes: 感染、傳染。infect sb with 是把某病傳給某人。

words.example: The infection needs a clean dressing.
words.exampleZh: 這個感染症需要乾淨的敷料。
words.notes: 傳染、傳染病。infection rate 是感染率。

words.example: The eye shows mild inflammation.
words.notes: 發炎，也可指燃燒。chronic inflammation 是慢性發炎。

words.example: Loose rugs can injure an older person.
words.exampleZh: 鬆動的地毯可能使年長者負傷。
words.notes: 傷害、損害。

words.example: The injured wrist is in a wrap.
words.notes: 受傷的、受損害的。

words.example: Report the injury before you leave.
words.exampleZh: 離開前請把負傷報上去。
words.notes: 傷害、損害。fatal injury 是致命傷。

words.example: High fever was once mistaken for insanity.
words.exampleZh: 高燒從前曾被誤當成精神錯亂。
words.notes: 精神錯亂。madness 是瘋狂。

words.example: The instability of the joint causes the limp.
words.notes: 不穩定、不穩固。

words.example: The knee clicks on the stairs.
words.exampleZh: 上下樓梯時膝蓋會喀喀響。
words.notes: 膝蓋。雙膝著地是跪下。

words.example: The child sat on her lap.
words.notes: 膝部、大腿上方，也可指下擺。動詞是折疊。last lap 是最後一圈。

words.example: The liver tests came back normal.
words.notes: 肝臟。weak liver 是肝功能不好。

words.example: One lung shows a shadow.
words.notes: 肺。lung capacity 是肺活量。

words.example: Malnutrition slowed the recovery.
words.notes: 營養不良。

words.example: Fever is one manifestation of the illness.
words.exampleZh: 發燒是這個病痛的一種病徵。
words.notes: 表現、顯示。clinical manifestation 是臨床表現。

words.example: The nightmare returned three nights in a row.
words.notes: 惡夢，也可指可怕的事物。

words.example: Some rashes originate from a new soap.
words.notes: 起自、起源，也可指創作。originate from 是來自。

words.example: The pain stays in one spot.
words.notes: 疼痛、痛苦。pain in the back 是背痛。

words.example: The cut is painful to the touch.
words.notes: 痛苦的、疼痛的。

words.example: The patient asked for a second opinion.
words.notes: 病人、患者。形容詞是有耐心的。

words.example: The plague closed the port for a month.
words.exampleZh: 瘟疫使港口關閉了一個月。
words.notes: 瘟疫，也可指麻煩或災禍。

words.example: A recurrence would need a new plan.
words.exampleZh: 若復發就需要新的計畫。
words.notes: 重現、復發。recurrence risk 是復發機率。

words.example: The child is sick and should stay home.
words.notes: 生病的。作名詞時指病人。

words.example: The bus ride brought on sickness.
words.notes: 噁心，也可指疾病。ailment 是小病。

words.example: The skull protected the brain.
words.notes: 顱骨。cranium 是頭蓋骨。

words.example: A sleepless night made the pain worse.
words.exampleZh: 失眠的一夜讓疼痛更重。
words.notes: 失眠的、不眠的。sleepless night 是不眠之夜。

words.example: One sneeze can travel across a room.
words.exampleZh: 一個噴嚏可以飄過整個房間。
words.notes: 噴嚏。考試裡多作不及物動詞。

words.example: A sprain needs rest and a wrap.
words.notes: 扭傷。twist 與 rick 也可指扭傷。

words.example: Many suffer quietly with joint pain.
words.exampleZh: 很多人默默承受關節疼痛。
words.notes: 忍受、受苦。suffer from 是患某種病。

words.example: Cold sweat covered his face.
words.notes: 出汗。名詞是汗水。

words.example: The ankle may swell by morning.
words.exampleZh: 腳踝到早上可能會腫起來。
words.notes: 腫脹、隆起。過去分詞常用 swollen，不規則。

words.example: The swollen finger will not bend.
words.notes: 腫起的、膨脹的。

words.example: She is too tired to finish the form.
words.notes: 勞累的、疲倦的，也可指厭煩的。be tired of 是厭煩。

words.example: The tongue has a white coat.
words.notes: 舌頭。tongue twister 是繞口令。sharp tongue 是說話刻薄。

words.example: One tonsil is larger than the other.
words.exampleZh: 一側扁桃腺比另一側大。
words.notes: 扁桃腺。tonsil inflammation 是扁桃腺發炎。

words.example: One tooth is loose.
words.notes: 牙、牙齒。複數是 teeth，不是規則變化。

words.example: The toothache kept her awake.
words.notes: 牙痛、牙疼。

words.example: The tumor is small.
words.notes: 腫瘤。tumor cell 是腫瘤細胞。

words.example: The ulcer is in the mouth.
words.notes: 潰瘍，也可指腐爛物。mouth ulcer 是口腔潰瘍。gastric ulcer 是胃潰瘍。

words.example: This virus spreads in close rooms.
words.exampleZh: 這種病毒在密閉房間裡傳播。
words.notes: 病毒。virus infection 是病毒感染。
